TEXT.English: Complexity: Advanced In unity lays our size! [H2]General[\H2] - Your cities have a 1 Tile Radius only. You will need to place them close together and build more cities than with other Civs. - Each City specializes on one Kith. - Your Army is split between normal Units and the Hero and national Units. Normal Units are weaker, while your hero and national units are stronger. [H2]Kith System[\H2] - Each City specializes on one Kith. Build the Kith Buildings for that. - Flodweard Kith: Cities with River Tiles and focus on Food production. - Nettere Kith: Cities on Coasts with strong Water Tile focus. - Tol Kith: Cities with focus on Research, Mutations and Magic. - Delfan Kith: Cities with focus on Mines, Production and Siege Weapons. - Feoh Kith: Cities with Trade focus. - Hild Kith: Cities with Military production focus. [H2]Army[\H2] - Your normal Units are weaker due to the Kith Militia promotion. - Your Heroes and National Unique Units are stronger due to the Kith Ealdor promotion. - Use your normal units as meatshields while protecting your strong elite Units.
